offering_description.value: The company underwrites Florida property insurance for condominium and homeowner associations, apartment communities, and assisted living facilities through two exclusive managing general agents. It also assumes a share of one agent’s excess and surplus lines property portfolio and supports the other agent’s program for related specialty property risks.

quotes.quote: American Coastal Insurance Company is the largest of commercial residential property in Florida. We write condominium, homeowner association, apartment, and assisted living business through two exclusive MGAs: AmRisc Group and Skyway Underwriters. We’ve done it.

The Florida commercial residential book is the anchor, not the boundary. American Coastal also assumes up to 5% of AmRisc’s E&S portfolio and supports the Skyway E&S program, applying the same catastrophe underwriting discipline to adjacent specialty property classes.
